summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Mark S. McNaughton. It describes him as a native of Harrisburg, Pennsylvania, and the son of a prominent regional land developer. It lists his education: high school at Central Dauphin East in 1981, a management and finance degree from Elizabethtown College in 1985, and a law degree from Widener University School of Law in 2003.
one_line: Biographical entry on Mark S. McNaughton, a Harrisburg, Pennsylvania native with degrees from Elizabethtown College and Widener University School of Law.
